ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface, characterized by high-contrast distal lobes and a dark medial region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the distal 2/3 of both lobes. A central black region forms a heart-shaped silhouette extending from the peduncle. Extensive 'salt and pepper' mottling exists at the transition zones, with discrete black focal spots scattered within the white distal fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 35 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations along the trailing edge; medial sections adjacent to the notch exhibit lower-frequency, high-amplitude 'waves', while distal sections towards the tips show higher-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve that sweeps upwards and outwards, terminating in sharp, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast, high-intensity white clusters (barnacles/scars) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least three parallel, dark diagonal rake marks are visible on the lower section of the left lobe. Several shorter, unaligned horizontal dark streaks are visible across the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal rake marks on the left lobe; dense white clusters (likely barnacles) on the terminal tips; a distinct '7-shaped' dark pigment mark on the far right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique dark pigment pattern resembling a numerical '7' or letter 'Z' located near the upper-outer edge of the right lobe.
